commands.verify: Verify your membership using your roster email
commands.source: View the shoot manager's source code
commands.postverify: Post the membership verification button in this channel
commands.upload: Preview and confirm a complete replacement of the member roster
commands.reconcile: Sync Discord roles with the current member roster

verification.unavailable: Verification is unavailable. Contact a server administrator.
verification.codeSent: If this email is on the member roster, you'll receive a code. Check your inbox and junk folder, then enter it below.
verification.emailFailed: Email delivery failed. Contact a server administrator.
verification.alreadyClaimed: This email is already linked to another Discord account. Contact a server administrator.
verification.roleFailed: Your code was accepted, but your Discord roles could not be confirmed. Contact a server administrator.
verification.post: Verify using your roster email to receive {memberRole}. Executives also receive {execRole}, and administrators receive {adminRole}.
verification.failed: Something went wrong. Contact a server administrator.
verification.starting: The bot is starting. Please try again shortly.

email.codeBody: Your verification code is {code}. Enter it in Discord within 15 minutes. If you did not request it, ignore this email.
email.testBody: This is a delivery test from your Discord membership bot.

admin.noRoster: There is no active member roster. Verification is closed.
admin.permissionRequired: You need the configured bot-administrator role or Discord Administrator permission.

errors.emailAbsent: That email is not on the active member roster
errors.ambiguousUnverified: Multiple Unverified roles exist. Set UNVERIFIED_ROLE_ID explicitly.

roleReasons.add: Member has no roles and needs to verify membership

shoot.command: Create and manage private shoot chats
shoot.notShoot: This channel is not a managed shoot chat.
shoot.permission: A configured bot administrator or Discord administrator must perform this action.
shoot.ineligible: <@{userId}> must have an eligible Discord role or Discord Administrator permission, and cannot be a bot.
shoot.joinDenied: You could not join. The joining window may have expired, the shoot may be closed or full, or you may lack an eligible role. Ask a bot administrator for help.
